title: Show
description: A single broadcast/episode. The atomic unit of analysis is the segment.

id.description: Stable show id, e.g. 'raw-2026-05-04'. Lowercase, hyphens only.

context.description: Short framing line: where this show sits in the broader build (go-home, post-PPV, debut night, etc.).

type.description: Kind of segment. 'angle' = physical without match; 'backstage' = pre-tape segment; 'video' = video package or recap.

position.description: Slotting in the show. Drives prominence weighting in temperature calc.

carriers.description: Character ids on screen carrying narrative weight. References characters.json.

threads_advanced.description: Threads moved forward this segment. References threads.json.

threads_closed.description: Threads paid off cleanly this segment.

threads_transformed.description: Threads that mutated into a new register this segment (e.g. feud absorbed into faction war).

outcome.description: For matches: who won how. For other types: what happened rhetorically. Free text.

stand_tall.description: Closing-image alignment. 'split' = ambiguous; 'none' = no clear stand-tall (e.g. squash with no aftermath).

register.description: Worked Shoot framework tier (Pantheon, Constant, Liminal-Warrior, etc.). Free string for now; will be enum when archetypes.json stabilizes.

notes.description: Free-text observation. Not used in compute; carries human-readable context.
